title: Australian Privacy Principles guidelines
issuer: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
legal_status: The APP guidelines are not legally binding and do not constitute legal advice about how an entity should comply with the APPs in particular circumstances.
authority: The Privacy Act 1988 (Privacy Act) s 28(1)(a) provides that the Australian Information Commissioner may make guidelines for the ‘avoidance of acts or practices that may or might be interferences with the privacy of individuals, or which may otherwise have any adverse effects on the privacy of individuals’.
